diff --git a/scripts/governance/check_root_structure.py b/scripts/governance/check_root_structure.py
new file mode 100755
index 00000000..dcf8b36c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/governance/check_root_structure.py
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL = {
+    ".clang-format",
+    ".clang-tidy",
+    ".cursorrules",
+    ".devcontainer",
+    ".editorconfig",
+    ".gitattributes",
+    ".github",
+    ".gitignore",
+    ".gitmodules",
+    ".pre-commit-config.yaml",
+    ".t81",
+    ".t81_canonfs",
+    "BUILD.bazel",
+    "CMakeLists.txt",
+    "CMakePresets.json",
+    "CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md",
+    "CONTRIBUTING.md",
+    "LICENSE",
+    "README.es.md",
+    "README.md",
+    "README.pt-BR.md",
+    "README.ru.md",
+    "README.zh-CN.md",
+    "SECURITY.md",
+    "artifacts",
+    "assets",
+    "benchmarks",
+    "book",
+    "cmake",
+    "contracts",
+    "core",
+    "docs",
+    "examples",
+    "experimental",
+    "include",
+    "internal",
+    "kernel",
+    "lang",
+    "legacy",
+    "logs",
+    "notebooks",
+    "package-lock.json",
+    "package.json",
+    "pdf",
+    "pyproject.toml",
+    "runtime",
+    "scripts",
+    "spec",
+    "src",
+    "tests",
+    "third_party",
+    "tooling",
+    "tools",
+}
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "ls-tree", "--name-only", "HEAD"],
+        cwd=root,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        print(proc.stdout)
+        print(proc.stderr)
+        return proc.returncode
+
+    current = {line.strip() for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()}
+    missing = sorted(EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL - current)
+    extra = sorted(current - EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL)
+
+    if missing or extra:
+        print("root structure check FAILED")
+        if missing:
+            print("- missing:")
+            for name in missing:
+                print(f"  - {name}")
+        if extra:
+            print("- unexpected:")
+            for name in extra:
+                print(f"  - {name}")
+        return 1
+
+    print("root structure check PASSED")
+    print(f"- entries checked: {len(current)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
